verdict.rationale: FireHydrant documents AI-Drafted Retrospectives. On incident resolution it generates a draft with a structured overview, timelines, impacts, and preliminary Lessons Learned, and a per-question "Draft with AI" button analyzes the incident's timeline, details, and context. These drafts land in editable retrospective templates with collaborative review. missing for 10: explicit coverage of contributing factors and follow-up/action items in the AI draft, independent or hands-on corroboration of draft quality.
